app.name: Lokum
flavor.gul.desc: The classic rosewater delight, blushing pink.
flavor.fistik.desc: Fresh pistachio green, calm and focused.
flavor.limon.desc: Sunny lemon zest for bright mornings.
flavor.nar.desc: Deep pomegranate red, bold and juicy.
flavor.nane.desc: Cool mint, crisp like a spring breeze.
flavor.sakiz.desc: Creamy mastic ivory, quiet and elegant.
flavor.gece.desc: Starry midnight plum for night owls.
flavor.karisik.desc: A box of assorted delights that slowly drifts through every color.
layout.arc.desc: Tabs, address bar and navigation live in a full-height sidebar. The page floats on your flavor.
layout.vertical.desc: Tabs in a sidebar, address bar on top. Familiar and roomy.
layout.horizontal.desc: Tabs across the top, like a classic browser.
spaces.deleted: Space deleted. Its tabs moved to the neighboring space.
spaces.clear.tooltip: Close all unpinned tabs in this space
palette.title: Command palette
update.card.title: Lokum {version}
settings.title: Lokum Settings
settings.search.none: No setting matches that. Try another word.
settings.appearance.subtitle: Pick a flavor and make Lokum look exactly the way you like.
settings.layout.subtitle: Sidebar or classic tabs — arrange your browser, Arc style.
settings.spaces.subtitle: Separate work, school and play. Each space has its own tabs, icon and flavor.
settings.tabs.subtitle: Keep your tab list tidy automatically.
settings.archive.subtitle: Tabs Lokum tidied away for you. Nothing is lost.
settings.privacy.subtitle: Strong protection by default, no telemetry, ever.
settings.search.subtitle: Choose how the address bar searches the web.
settings.shortcuts.subtitle: Fly through Lokum with your keyboard.
settings.language.subtitle: Lokum speaks twelve languages.
settings.updates.subtitle: Fresh batches arrive automatically from GitHub.
settings.advanced.subtitle: Import, export, reset and power-user tools.
settings.about.subtitle: A Turkish delight of a browser, built on Firefox.
settings.appearance.accent.desc: Override the flavor's accent with your own color.
settings.appearance.sugar.desc: Tiny sparkles that twinkle in the sidebar, like sugar on a lokum.
settings.appearance.grain.desc: A subtle paper texture over the window background.
settings.appearance.animations.desc: Reduced keeps color fades but removes movement.
settings.appearance.radius.desc: How round the page card's corners are.
settings.appearance.margin.desc: Space between the page and the window edges.
settings.appearance.shadow.desc: Lets the page float softly above the frame.
settings.layout.compact.desc: More room for pages. The sidebar slides in when your pointer touches the window edge (Ctrl+Alt+S).
settings.layout.floatingUrlbar.desc: The address bar opens big and centered over the page, like Arc.
settings.layout.mediaCard.desc: Control music and videos from other tabs right in the sidebar.
settings.spaces.enabled.desc: Group tabs into spaces you can switch between with Ctrl+Alt+← / →.
settings.spaces.tint.desc: Each space shows its own flavor, so you always know where you are.
settings.spaces.swipe.desc: Scroll sideways over the sidebar (or Shift + wheel) to change space.
settings.spaces.hint: Tip: drag a tab onto a space icon at the bottom of the sidebar to move it.
settings.spaces.confirmDelete: Delete “{space}”? Its tabs will move to another space.
settings.tabs.autoArchive.desc: Unpinned tabs you haven't opened for a while are closed and kept in the Archive.
settings.tabs.sleep.desc: Unload background tabs to save memory and battery. They reload when you come back.
settings.tabs.restore.desc: Open your windows and tabs from last time.
settings.tabs.hoverPreview.desc: Show a preview card when hovering over a tab.
settings.tabs.groups.desc: Group related tabs with a name and a color.
settings.tabs.splitView.desc: Show two tabs side by side.
settings.tabs.pip.desc: A playing video pops out when you switch to another tab.
settings.archive.confirmClear: Remove every tab from the archive?
settings.archive.empty: The archive is empty. Tabs appear here when auto-archive tidies up.
settings.privacy.tracking.desc: Strict blocks more trackers but may break a few sites.
settings.privacy.adblock.desc: Install uBlock Origin, the free and open-source content blocker.
settings.privacy.https.desc: Always use secure connections and warn before visiting an insecure site.
settings.privacy.doh.desc: Encrypt your DNS lookups (DNS over HTTPS).
settings.privacy.gpc: Tell websites not to sell my data
settings.privacy.gpc.desc: Sends the Global Privacy Control signal.
settings.privacy.fingerprinting.desc: Makes it harder for sites to identify your device.
settings.privacy.clearOnExit.desc: Choose exactly what gets cleared in Firefox settings.
settings.privacy.telemetry.desc: Lokum never sends usage data. Crash reports and experiments are switched off.
settings.privacy.more.desc: Cookies, permissions, passwords and site data.
settings.search.suggest.desc: Show suggestions from your search engine as you type.
settings.search.manage.desc: Add, remove or reorder search engines and shortcuts.
settings.shortcuts.enabled.desc: Turn off if a shortcut clashes with a website or app you use.
settings.language.restart: Restart Lokum to finish switching the language everywhere.
settings.language.web.desc: Choose which languages websites should show.
settings.updates.auto.desc: Downloads in the background and installs silently when you close Lokum.
settings.updates.portable.desc: Portable Lokum tells you about updates; download the new zip from GitHub to update.
settings.updates.releases.desc: Every version, with release notes, on GitHub.
settings.updates.status.upToDate: Lokum is up to date · checked {time}
settings.advanced.default.desc: Open links from other apps in Lokum.
settings.advanced.import.desc: Bring bookmarks, passwords, history and more from Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera…
settings.advanced.export.desc: Save your Lokum settings and spaces to a file.
settings.advanced.importSettings.desc: Load settings from a file exported by Lokum.
settings.advanced.importFailed: That file doesn't look like Lokum settings.
settings.advanced.profile.desc: Where your bookmarks, history and settings live.
settings.advanced.reset.desc: Restores every Lokum option to its default. Tabs, spaces and data are kept.
settings.advanced.reset.confirm: Reset all Lokum settings to their defaults?
settings.advanced.userChrome.desc: For tinkerers: load your own styles from the profile's chrome folder.
settings.advanced.firefoxSettings.desc: Everything else — passwords, downloads, certificates, performance…
settings.about.credits.desc: Lokum is built on Mozilla Firefox and inspired by the Arc browser. Firefox is a trademark of the Mozilla Foundation; Lokum is an independent project and is not affiliated with Mozilla. Source code: MPL 2.0.
welcome.intro.title: Welcome to [Lokum]
welcome.intro.subtitle: A browser as sweet as Turkish delight. Let's pick your flavor, your layout and your spaces — it only takes a minute.
welcome.flavor.title: Pick your [flavor]
welcome.flavor.subtitle: Every lokum colors the whole browser. Tap a piece — you can change it any time.
welcome.layout.title: How do you like your [tabs]?
welcome.layout.subtitle: Choose Arc-style sidebar, vertical tabs or the classic tab strip. You'll see it change behind this screen.
welcome.spaces.title: Make some [spaces]
welcome.spaces.subtitle: Spaces keep parts of your life apart. Each has its own tabs and flavor.
welcome.spaces.hint: Switch spaces with the icons at the bottom of the sidebar or Ctrl+Alt+← / →.
welcome.import.title: Bring your [stuff]
welcome.import.subtitle: Import bookmarks, passwords, history and more from the browsers on this computer.
welcome.import.none: No other browsers found. You can import later from Settings.
welcome.privacy.title: Your data stays [yours]
welcome.privacy.subtitle: Lokum blocks trackers out of the box and never sends telemetry.
welcome.privacy.standard.desc: Blocks social trackers, cross-site cookies, cryptominers and fingerprinters. Everything keeps working.
welcome.privacy.strict.desc: Also blocks tracking content in every window. Stronger, but some sites may break.
welcome.privacy.adblock.desc: Recommended — free, open source and light.
welcome.privacy.doh.desc: Encrypt the addresses you look up.
welcome.privacy.telemetry.desc: Nothing about your browsing leaves this device.
welcome.finish.title: Your Lokum is [ready]
welcome.finish.subtitle: Press Ctrl+K any time for the command palette, and find every option in Lokum Settings.
